title: SIFMA-recommended US fixed-income early close, 2:00 p.m. ET — the last session before Good Friday, with equities open all day
source: NEWS: sifma.org/resources/guides-playbooks/holiday-schedule ('Holiday Schedule', SIFMA's own US Holiday Recommendations panel), fetched direct 2026-09-05 (HTTP 200, 298,926 bytes). The 2027 panel is a hidden tab whose text the rendered page drops, so this session parsed it out of the page's own embedded payload: the US 2027 Good Friday entry renders as three fields — heading 'Good Friday', date 'Friday, March 26, 2027', note 'Early Close (2:00 p.m. Eastern Time): Thursday, March 25, 2027'. The same field shape reproduces on the panel's other entries (e.g. Memorial Day 'Monday, May 31, 2027' with 'Early Close (2:00 p.m. Eastern Time): Friday, May 28, 2027'), so the note attaches to the holiday it precedes. Cross-checked against the US 2026 entry, which has the OPPOSITE shape — no full-close date and the note 'Early Close (12:00 p.m. Eastern Time): Friday, April 3, 2026', i.e. a bond half-session on Good Friday itself. Filed estimate on three counts: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy in market-events-data.ts has no slot for an industry trade association's recommended schedule, this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep, and SIFMA's own press release states verbatim that its closes are 'recommendations only; each member firm should decide for itself whether its fixed income departments remain open for trading' and that 'all SIFMA recommendations are subject to change due to market conditions'
notes: DISCOVERED during the good-friday-market-closure-2027-03-26 initial research (2026-09-05). Why a bond-market early close earns a row: this is the one dated session in the March 2027 corridor where the two asset classes keep DIFFERENT hours. Equities trade a full session to 16:00 ET (NYSE's own early-close list carries no 2027-03-25 entry) while the recommended fixed-income tape shuts at 14:00 ET, two hours earlier — so any cross-asset construction loses its bond-side reference before the equity close, and the following session (Good Friday 2027-03-26) is dark in both. It is also the LAST session of the compressed post-witching window that the sibling opex-2027-03-19 ledger's FT-opex-2027-03-19-1 measures (Mon 03-22 through Thu 03-25, four sessions instead of the usual five), which means the window's final print is taken on a session with an atypical liquidity profile — a measurement caveat that forward test does not currently carry. IMPACT LOW AND STRUCTURAL ONLY: a recommended early close is not a market-wide halt, it moves nothing by itself, and no house playbook is calendar- or holiday-keyed (docs/plans/trade-playbooks.md and docs/research/multi-symbol-sweep.md grepped for 'holiday|good friday|closure|half-day|early close' this session: zero hits in both). It widens caution about the 03-25 afternoon and licenses nothing. HONEST LIMIT ON THE KIND FIELD: EventKind (src/domain/market-events-types.ts) has no market-structure member, so this is filed 'rates' — the closest fit, since SIFMA's recommendation governs US dollar-denominated government, mortgage- and asset-backed, corporate and municipal debt plus secondary money-market trading. The same imperfect-fit note the sibling closure entry carries applies here; whether the union needs a 'market-structure' member is not this lane's call. SECOND HONEST LIMIT: whether CME's rate futures keep their own separate hours that afternoon is NOT asserted — cmegroup.com returned HTTP 403 to this runner twice and its Good Friday clearing advisory PDF also 403'd, so the futures leg is unresearched rather than assumed.
